Name: Xavier Custom NPC
Author: Mylittlestarr
Description:
This is a mod that adds Xavier (沈星回) from Love and Deepspace (恋与深空) to Stardew Valley as a Barchelor NPC. Still in progress, new features will be added from time to time!
I wanted to play with Xavier, so I made him with the help from a few other little stars and will release it so everyone can enjoy!
Do not reupload anywhere, this mod is 100% volunteer work and 100% free, me and the other fans worked hard for it to work.


[size=4][b]-AVAILABLE LANGUAGES[/b] [/size](right now): English, (Simplified Chinese}, Portuguese and Spanish.
Soon-to-be-added: Russian and Korean.
Need volunteers: French, Japanese.

-You'll need : Content Patcher﻿ (for this mod to function), TrinketTinker (for following npc) and Portraiture (for portraits).
[size=4]-How to install:[/size]
 Please drop the mod file in your Mods folder and the Portraiture file inside Mods/Portraiture/Portraits
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38597/38597-1760629326-1884490633.gif[/img]
[size=3]-QUESTIONS:[/size]
"The portrait is blank": please press P when speaking to Xavier to select one of his seasonal portraits.
"Can I marry him?": Yes.
"Can I have children with him?": Yes, children custom sprites included in mod.
"Can I play this mod on Multiplayer?": Yes.
"Does it conflict with other Custom NPCs?": You can play it together with any of the other creator's LADS LIs mods!
"Is this character overriding any other NPC?": No, this is a 100% Custom NPC.
Any other issues send your question in the comments and I'll help you.

[size=6][b]ADITIONAL FEATURES (EXPERIMENTAL)[/b][/size]
How to make Xavier follow you: First, go to the travelling vendor in Cindersap forest and buy "Xavier's Star Tassel" from him, then he'll start automatically following you. to make him stop buy the Unequip Xavier item at the same shop (you'll need to buy the tassel again to reequip him).
What can he do? He will follow you, collect items, glow in the dark and change to hunter outfit in caves.
